title: The Portal Theory: Dimensional Collapse and Photon Inversion in a Two-World Correlation Geometry
summary: We present a geometric interpretation of black holes as dimensional crossover points where the effective dimension D(r) approaches zero. At this crossover, photons are absorbed and re-emitted into an inverse world where the sky is light and the stars are black. A continuity equation with a divergence at D=0 and a jump condition at the crossover describes photon flux between the two worlds. The theory provides a unified framework for understanding black hole thermodynamics and the origin of cosmic background radiation.

review.reason: Geometric theory relating black hole crossover points to photon flux between two worlds.
